mentions.name: CommonForms
mentions.description: CommonForms is a dataset and paper for training ML models on PDF forms. It was built by scraping CommonCrawl for hundreds of thousands of fillable form pages, which are used as a training set for form field detection.
mentions.source_excerpt:
That’s built on a dataset and paper I wrote called CommonForms, where I scraped CommonCrawl for hundreds of thousands of fillable form pages and used that as a training set:

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16506
